candidate_claims: The proposed all-order QQ1 anchor-auxiliary obstruction is false.

The fixed order-18 graph has exact parameter vector (gamma,i,alpha,gamma_infinity,theta)=(2,3,3,3,3), realizes the named QQ1 collision, hot-layer states, cross-layer bridge, and outer bow tie, and has no dominating pair incident with the distinguished independent triple T={x,p,q}.
The graph nevertheless has exactly thirty dominating pairs away from T, including {u,14}; hence protecting every pair touching T does not imply gamma=3.
